clips.title: The story
paras: Tucked away in the eastern corner of Old Town, this unassuming stone manor houses the headquarters of SI:7, the kingdom of Stormwind's elite intelligence and espionage service. Behind its heavy doors, spymaster Master Mathias Shaw and his senior operatives quietly monitor threats to the realm, coordinating undercover agents across the kingdom.

To the casual passerby in Old Town, this fortified stone structure looks little different from a standard manor or military barracks. In truth, it serves as the nerve center for Stormwind Intelligence, Section 7. Directed by Master Mathias Shaw, SI:7 gathers intelligence, conducts surveillance, and executes covert operations to protect the kingdom from subversion. While the city guard patrols the open cobblestones and the Royal Guard defends Stormwind Keep, SI:7 works in the margins, training handlers and dispatching stealthy operatives against foreign enemies, saboteurs, and domestic unrest alike.
